name: Morioka (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with a white ring enclosing a four-pointed compass lozenge.
history: The flag of Morioka bears the city's mon (municipal emblem) in the Japanese civic tradition of a single stylised mark on a plain field.

features.role: Morioka municipal emblem — a white ring enclosing a four-pointed compass lozenge
